summary: Candidate PR 498 does not fix issue 510: it changes only report files and leaves the implementation identical to base. The exact historical global_window_accuracy test and global_window path are absent on both revisions, so the reported ExtUIOp/zext failure could not be reproduced from the prepared checkout. The closest current PA SWA path passed the reported numerical configuration minus unavailable global_window=3, plus four 1023/1024 boundary cases, against Torch on gfx950 at the existing tolerance. Those passes cover only the redesigned current sliding-window path and do not verify the historical zext path.

tests.command: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 FLYDSL_RUNTIME_ENABLE_CACHE=0 PYTHONPATH=/job/repo/python:/job/repo /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-f80f37624eb3/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 'tests/kernels/test_pa_swa.py::test_multi_case_set[global_window_accuracy]' -s (run separately at base and candidate)
tests.what_was_measured: Availability of the exact regression named by the source issue. Both revisions report that tests/kernels/test_pa_swa.py does not exist; the current source also has no global_window argument or _widen_nonnegative_i32_to_i64 helper.

tests.command: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 AITER_USE_SYSTEM_TRITON=1 FLYDSL_RUNTIME_ENABLE_CACHE=0 XDG_CACHE_HOME=/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-f80f37624eb3/review-cache PYTHONPATH=/job/repo/python:/job/repo /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-f80f37624eb3/venv/bin/python -c 'import tests.kernels.test_pa as t; t.HAS_GLUON=False; t.run_pa_decode_ps_test(context_length=3000,batch_size=128,num_heads=(12,2),head_size=128,block_size=1024,compute_type=t.dtypes.d_dtypes["fp8"],query_length=4,quant_mode="per_token",context_partition_size=256,trans_v=True,kv_varlen=False,sliding_window=1023)'
tests.what_was_measured: Closest current FlyDSL PA SWA GPU path using all reported numerical parameters except unavailable global_window=3. The device result passed the independent Torch reference using the repository's unchanged sliding-window atol=rtol=5e-2.

tests.command: Same direct current-path harness for (context_length, sliding_window) = (3000,1022), (3000,1024), (1024,1023), (1025,1023), batch_size=16
tests.what_was_measured: Four adversarial boundary cases around the reported 1023 window and 1024 physical-page edge; all passed the independent Torch reference at the unchanged sliding-window tolerance.

tests.command: Repository tests/kernels/test_pa.py CLI with the closest reported parameters and AITER_USE_SYSTEM_TRITON=1
tests.what_was_measured: The optional Gluon comparison fails to compile with the installed Triton 3.5.1, reporting invalid intrinsic shape, before FlyDSL runs. The direct FlyDSL-versus-Torch harness was therefore used for the numerical checks; this dependency failure is not labeled as a FlyDSL correctness result.

gpu_execution_evidence: The direct current-path runs launched FlyDSL on the assigned AMD Instinct MI350X, reported as gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, and compared its outputs with the Torch reference. The exact historical zext/global-window kernel was absent and therefore did not execute.
remaining_limitations: Neither prepared base nor candidate contains the exact tests/kernels/test_pa_swa.py::test_multi_case_set[global_window_accuracy] regression or a global_window API.

The current PA SWA implementation uses a redesigned pointer-addressing path and has no _widen_nonnegative_i32_to_i64 helper, so its passing results cannot establish whether historical ExtUIOp codegen is fixed.
Candidate PR 498 contains no implementation change and no executable regression; its retained historical artifacts were not treated as local execution evidence.
The optional AITER Gluon comparison is incompatible with the installed Triton version and fails before FlyDSL execution; the independent Torch reference path remained available.
No native rebuild was appropriate because the candidate makes no C++ changes.
